name: Bear, The AO Teddy
desc: Ready to welcome a new teddy to the family? Say hello to Bear, affectionately known as AOs Chief Smile-maker and the ultimate cuddle buddy, hes looking for his fur-ever home. With a friendly AO smile embroidered on his tummy, hes the perfect sidekick for all your little ones adventures. And if he gets mucky from building sandcastles on the beach, all hell need is a quick wipe to be ready to storm the next pillow fort at home.Want to learn more about Bear? Head over to his channel for games, activities, competitions, and more to enjoy with the whole family.

name: Nextbase 522GW Quad HD Dash Cam - Silver
desc: Capture every single detail of your journey with this Nextbase dash cam. Its got a Quad HD resolution thatll pick up bumps, number plates, road signs  you name it, itll see it. So, if anything happens, youll have all the proof you need. Especially since its wide-angle lens shows the entire road ahead, including any parked cars. Not sure how to get started? The touchscreen makes it easy. Just tap the option you want and away you go. Itll even record in the same high-quality after sunset thanks to night vision mode. Plus, youll be in safe hands with the Emergency SOS system. It connects to your phone, and sends an alert to emergency services if it detects a crash.

name: Nextbase 322GW HD Dash Cam - Silver
desc: Keep an extra eye on the road with this Nextbase dash cam. It captures footage in smooth HD, so youll always have a reliable record of your journey. Well, its touchscreen means you wont be sat on the driveway setting it up for ages. Plus, if you do have a bump while on the road, itll automatically save any footage. Thats one less thing to worry about.

name: Nextbase 622GW 4K Ultra HD Dash Cam - Silver
desc: Leave your worries at home with this Nextbase dash cam. Itll catch everything going on around you thanks to the wide-viewing angle and an amazing 4K resolution. So, you can drive with complete confidence, knowing that all those important little details  like number plates and road signs  are being recorded as clearly as possible. And night-time wont be a problem either. Youll still get the same high-quality when the suns gone down. The touchscreen makes it really easy to set up too  all youve got to do is tap the option you need. Easy-peasy. Plus, the ClickGo PRO mount uses magnets to fix it in place, meaning installation is a doddle.
